publication_scope: Owner-authorized research-only public projection, not a live config or purchased raw market dataset. Original private artifacts unchanged. No replay rerun for publication.

design.evaluation_role: chronological Development, not T1/T2 or untouched confirmation
design.initialization: Each arm starts at the same flat segment boundary with 24-hour D-1 native/feature warmup, then carries its own state continuously. Not a historical live checkpoint.
design.label_semantics: One E WAIT or C CANCEL intervention, then B0. POST-minus-WAIT or KEEP-minus-CANCEL at the common absolute terminal, including fees and funding. Labels are not additive returns.
design.target_selection: Apr22/May1: first 8 eligible per surface/side by 00:45 UTC, retain fewer when absent; no selection by eventual fill or value. Apr20 prior 23 pilot labels retained unchanged.
design.horizon_sensitivity: First available Apr22 target per surface extended to a two-hour terminal; separate from fit and original one-hour labels.
design.baseline_strategy: Existing private B0 and post-fill protections held fixed; private deployed policy/config/model bundles omitted. This research policy is an extra replay-only E/C filter.
design.execution: Python canonical F01 replay with strict native snapshot/delta modeled queue; REST async GLOBAL FIFO, local private-fill visibility, source/prediction delivery, frozen fees and physical-time funding.
design.latency_boundary: Existing measured pilot L0 plus historical priors, not a stable multi-regime tail qualification. Incremental candidate compute/hosting cost not integrated.

current_scorer_thresholds.missing_model: preserve baseline; do not impute or borrow another side

publication_time_training_coverage.scope: Descriptive re-fit check using the same 43 rows and parameters; not a new selected policy.

may1_frozen_model_evaluation.normalization: unchanged frozen policy training-only means/scales; no fit or normalization recomputation used for predictions
may1_frozen_model_evaluation.target_direction: POST-minus-WAIT for E; KEEP-minus-CANCEL for C
may1_frozen_model_evaluation.metric_contract: Canonical trainer MSE and past-only training-label mean MSE; descriptive MAE/RMSE, exact three-way sign accuracy and frozen-zero-threshold action direction. No new statistical gate or threshold. Error/sign metrics use supported rows only; all unsupported rows remain listed.
limitations: One common one-hour May1 outcome window; labels are correlated and not an independent sample of 18 days.
May1 is later chronological Development, not untouched confirmation.
C:BUY has eight labeled outcomes but no frozen model, so prediction error/direction metrics are null and baseline KEEP fallback is explicit.
C:SELL has a frozen model but no May1 targets under the predeclared cutoff; no time-out score is available.
Current labels use modeled queue/latency and common terminal MTM, not exact checkpoint branching or additive portfolio PnL.
Prediction results do not stop the ongoing frozen full-path research or authorize parameter changes.

matched_participation_control.eligibility: Within each own E/C/EC trajectory: active-mode surface and finite non-null value_delta_usdc
matched_participation_control.veto_definition: E WAIT / C CANCEL among supported opportunities; no PnL, value magnitude, pooling or Evaluation selection
matched_participation_control.missing_surface_rule: Omit missing rates, retain explicit simulator fallback; never impute zero or borrow another mode
matched_participation_control.degenerate_rates: All observed supported rates are 0 or 1; retain these deterministic boundary controls without retuning

arms.reason: Frozen C SELL cancel probability is zero; C BUY is unsupported and keeps baseline. No E actions. Thus every control intervention is a no-op.

limitations: Five UTC days are one continuous segment, not five independent observations.
R_C is only a baseline economic alias; no control runtime or reference counters were executed.
No scorecard profile or OPE adapter is retrofitted; ranking/CI/Sharpe are unavailable.
Fees are in trading PnL; funding is added once; campaign attribution is not additional PnL.
Native source counters and modeled queue ambiguity remain separate recorded diagnostics.
Incremental inference delay is unmodeled; the Mac benchmark is not deployment-host latency.
full_path_summary.passed_scope_note: Every passed flag below means completed-artifact monetary reconciliation only, not model quality, exact queue, source parity, or deployment admission.
